key_highlights:
- You can choose your card design and material (Eco-Friendly, Metal, or Plastic)
- Fuel Surcharge Waiver: Get a 1% fuel surcharge waiver for purchases made at fuel stations across the country.
- Domestic Lounge Program: Enjoy complimentary entry to a domestic airport lounge four times per quarter as a primary cardholder.
- Complimentary Mastercard Golf World Program: Enjoy a lesson and then play in low-cost rounds four rounds of golf every year for free.
- EMI on Call: Use the online or call service to convert payments into EMIs at competitive interest rates.
- Quick Loans: Obtain loans within one's own limit to cover urgent financial needs.
- YES Pay: Make direct payment of your monthly bills every month using the YES Pay feature.
- Contactless Transactions: Use the technology for contactless transactions at many quick, simple, and secure locations.
- Control Your Card: Control the domestic and international credit limits of your card, manage card block/unlock, etc.
- Card Protection Plan: Protect yourself from card theft, loss, and other fraud as well as emergencies.
- Secure Online Transactions: Use Verified by Visa or Mastercard SecureCode to keep your online transactions secure.
- Cashback: 50% cashback will be provided on the merchants that you have chosen.

miscellaneous: The YES Bank BYOC Credit Card allows you to customize the texture and design of the card. BYOC stands for Build Your Own Card. The card comes with impressive benefits, travel benefits, reward points, etc. The credit card is available in three variants: A Metal, a Plastic Card, and an Eco-Friendly card. The process for the YES Bank BYOC Credit Card is simple and can be completed online.

faqs.Does one BYOC Reward variant have a cap: No, one-time purchases (aside from fuel purchases) can not earn an unlimited number of reward points (Reward Points for every Rs. 95-200 spent).
faqs.What distinguishes the YES Bank BYOC Cre: The YES Bank BYOC Credit Card allows you to customize your card, including the material of the image that appears on the card, the businesses you want to receive cashback from, and the offers or cashback you want.
faqs.How can I apply for the YES Bank BYOC Cr: You can visit the official YES Bank website to apply for the YES Bank BYOC Credit Card.
faqs.Can I contact YES Bank after my YES Bank: The YES Bank BYOC Credit Card can only be made by you; the changes can only be made later. The features and benefits cannot be altered by bank employees; you can go to the "Card" tab on the preferences screen of the YES Mobile App or the YES Bank portal to choose the plan, unsubscribe, or modify the plans.
faqs.Can my subscription plan be changed?: Yes, you can change the subscription plan; but the changes will take effect with the next statement cycle and be charged accordingly.
